blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. Twelve divided by negative three, plus six times negative two.
Division and multiplication come before addition. Twelve divided by negative three is negative four. Six times negative two is negative twelve.
Adding two negatives gives a bigger negative. Negative four plus negative twelve is negative sixteen.
So the answer is negative sixteen.
Watch out for these traps. If you drop the negative on the two, you get eight. If you add before multiplying, you get negative four.
